output.reason: I find it convincing: the cause it names (a pay-rule change to the night premium on 22 Oct, logged as a label fix and never tested) explains why only the night premium was short, and the brief backs this with the audit trail, a recalculation where each shortfall matches 20:00–22:00 to within a penny, and a test re-run that corrects all 158 night workers; the actions are clear and properly turn down Malcolm's proposals, though it says little about the rota-trial decision or how to take this up with Ardentra.
